# M1 Aviation

> M1 Aviation is the next-generation digital ecosystem for business aviation, uniting an AI-powered pre-owned aircraft marketplace, SIOS (Super Intelligent Operating System), and an elite vetted industry partner alliance.

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [M1 Marketplace](https://m1.rsinternational.net/marketplace): Premier private jet marketplace offering 100% verified listings, market intelligence, institutional escrow, and the proprietary 7-Step Assisted Acquisition process for buyers and sellers.
- [SIOS - Super Intelligent Operating System](https://m1.rsinternational.net/saios): AI-driven autonomous operating intelligence system that unifies aircraft telemetry, maintenance provenance, regulatory compliance, 6 core avionics functions, and a Top 30 Unified Aviation Tools Matrix into an autonomous digital layer.
- [Industry Partner Alliance](https://m1.rsinternational.net/industry-partner): Global network of accredited aviation brokers, Part 145 MRO facilities, and charter operators (including BN Aviation, ATM Jets, Velari Jets, and 7IVS) providing verified transactional execution and preferred operational benefits.
- [AVI Times](https://m1.rsinternational.net/aviation-times): Authority research and market intelligence publication covering aerospace supply chains, VC investment trends in Avi-Tech, and autonomous aviation futures.

## Leadership & Founder's Vision

- **Founder, M1 Aviation & SIOS**: Areez Rao
  > "Our Vision with SIOS is to create SuperIntelligences so strong that it ends up knowing the aircraft; they're connected with more than any human naturally is capable of. We need to induce extreme efficiency in aviation and avoid being afraid of emerging technologies, in order to keep with the human curiosity and need to fly and explore the earth and beyond."
- **Co-Founder & CEO**: Rayyan Shuja

## SIOS: 6 Core Avionics Functions & Top 30 Unified Tools Matrix

1. **Extreme Compute Density**: Real-time flight envelope telemetry ingestion and avionics bus interfacing.
2. **Autonomous Decision Heuristics**: Fleet-wide algorithmic optimization and routing.
3. **Ultra-Low-Latency Avionics Core**: Direct connection to onboard bus telemetry.
4. **Connected Global Grid**: Unifying aircraft, flight crews, dispatchers, and Part 145 MRO repair stations.
5. **Immutable Digital Provenance**: Eliminating paper logbooks with tamper-proof maintenance records.
6. **Proactive Airworthiness Compliance**: Automated FAA, EASA, and ICAO Airworthiness Directives (ADs) and Service Bulletins (SBs) tracking.
- **Top 30 Unified Tools**: Integrates and bridges legacy silos across Flight Planning (ForeFlight, Jeppesen, Garmin Pilot), MRO Maintenance (CAMP Systems, Flightdocs, Veryon, TRAX, AMOS), Operations & Dispatch (Avianis, FL3XX, FOS), Charter (Avinode), and Live Telemetry (FlightAware, ADS-B Exchange).

## Key Publications & Market Research

- [The Jet Bottleneck: The Fork in the Future of Aviation!](https://m1.rsinternational.net/aviation-times/jet-bottleneck-fork-future-aviation): September edition analyzing global OEM order backlogs exceeding 16,000 aircraft, supply chain shortages, and the strategic fork between overproduction and disciplined undersupply.
- [Bloom of Aviation - 2 Edition (VC Special)](https://m1.rsinternational.net/aviation-times/bloom-of-aviation-2-edition-vc-special): Venture capital analysis on business aviation market cycles, Peter Thiel, Palantir's aviation software expansion, and tech investment in autonomous aerospace.
- [Future of Private Aviation](https://m1.rsinternational.net/aviation-times/future-of-private-aviation-man-manual): Strategic overview examining why aircraft management will transition from manual spreadsheets and paper records to AI and DePIN systems.
